# ---- a function's code (B11d) ----

# what explain -asm and -ir read: the code's text - assembly or IR, a file a part (the link's one under full link-time
# optimization, one a ThinLTO task, one a module under -quick) - and the files of LLVM's remarks, the objects' and the
# link's
type Listed struct() {
    Parts Vec<String&>
    Remarks Vec<String&>
}

# explain -asm/-ir FILE NAME (B11d): the program FILE is the root of built as build builds it - its objects, each with
# its remarks (c.Listing) - and its code generated as the link generates it, into build/listing/NAME/, written afresh:
# the assembly the link's code generator writes or the IR it reads, which the linker's LTO plugin writes in place of a
# program (emit-asm, emit-llvm), its remarks beside it. Under -quick, where code is final once a module is compiled, each
# module is compiled again to assembly or IR, with its remarks. Fails, having reported why, where it does not build
fn ListingCode<F Frontend>(fe mut F&, c mut Config&, file String&, ir Bool, prog mut Program&, d mut diag.Diagnostics&) Listed ? Failed {
    try fe.Analyze(file, Kind.Program, c, prog, d)
    if d.Errors() > 0 or prog.Units.Len() == 0 { error Failed.Reported }
    try c.ensureDir(d)
    dir := $c.Dir "/listing/" $Readable(prog.rootIdentity())
    try os.RemoveAll(dir) catch os.Error { }
    try os.MkDirAll(dir) catch os.Error {
        fileFatal(dir, msgs.CannotOpen(), d)
        error Failed.Reported
    }
    out := Listed()
    if c.Quick {
        try c.listQuick(prog, dir, ir, out, d)
        return out
    }
    objs := try c.Objects(prog, d)
    Phase("compile")
    for o in objs {
        if os.Exists(RemarksOf(o)) { out.Remarks.Push(RemarksOf(o)) }
    }
    try c.listLink(objs, prog, dir, ir, out, d)
    return out
}

# B11d: the objects linked as Link links them, the plugin writing the code it generates (or, ir, the IR it generates
# it from) into dir as code, code1 ... - a ThinLTO link's tasks each their own - and its remarks as link.yaml...; IR
# written as bitcode is turned into text by clang, which reads bitcode and writes it back as text unchanged
fn (c mut Config&) listLink(objs Vec<String&>&, prog Program&, dir String&, ir Bool, out mut Listed&, d mut diag.Diagnostics&) ? Failed {
    args Vec<String&>
    args.Push($c.Clang)
    for f in c.ModeFlags() { args.Push($f) }
    if c.Thin {
        # a ThinLTO link's code kept by what it is made from, as Link's is - apart from a program's, and asm from IR
        args.Push($"-Wl,-plugin-opt,cache-dir=" $c.Dir "/thinlto-" $("ir" if ir else "asm"))
        args.Push($"-Wl,-plugin-opt,-import-instr-limit=" $ImportLimit)
    }
    args.Push("-Wl,-plugin-opt=emit-llvm" if ir else "-Wl,-plugin-opt=emit-asm")
    args.Push($"-Wl,-plugin-opt=opt-remarks-filename=" $dir "/link.yaml")
    args.Push($"-Wl,-plugin-opt=opt-remarks-passes=" $RemarkPasses)
    args.Push("-o")
    args.Push($dir "/code")
    for o in objs { args.Push($o) }
    for x in prog.Links { args.Push($x) }
    for x in String&["-lm", "-lpthread", "-ldl"] { args.Push($x) }
    if prog.Dyncall != "" { args.Push("-lffi") }
    if c.Clang == "" { error Failed.Unbuilt }
    ran := try os.Exec(...args.ToArray()) catch os.Error default os.Output(127, "", "")
    if ran.Status != 0 {
        sayErr($ran.Stdout $ran.Stderr)
        d.Fatal(diag.Where.Nowhere, msgs.LinkFailed($dir "/code"))
        error Failed.Reported
    }
    c.Linked++
    names Vec<String&>
    listed := try os.ReadDir(dir) catch os.Error default Array<String&>(0)
    for n in listed { names.Push($n) }
    names.Sort(fn(a String&, b String&) Bool { return a.Len() < b.Len() or (a.Len() == b.Len() and a < b) })
    for n in names {
        if n.StartsWith("link.yaml") { out.Remarks.Push($dir "/" $n) }
        if not n.StartsWith("code") { continue }
        if not ir {
            out.Parts.Push($dir "/" $n)
            continue
        }
        out.Parts.Push(try c.bitcodeText($dir "/" $n, d))
    }
}

# B11d: the bitcode at bc written as text beside it (bc.ll) by clang, no pass run over it
fn (c Config&) bitcodeText(bc String&, d mut diag.Diagnostics&) String ? Failed {
    args Vec<String&>
    args.Push($c.Clang)
    if c.Target.Foreign { args.Push($"--target=" $c.Target.Triple) }
    for a in String&["-S", "-emit-llvm", "-x", "ir", "-Xclang", "-disable-llvm-passes", "-o", $bc ".ll", bc] { args.Push($a) }
    ran := try os.Exec(...args.ToArray()) catch os.Error default os.Output(127, "", "")
    if ran.Status != 0 {
        sayErr($ran.Stdout $ran.Stderr)
        d.Fatal(diag.Where.Nowhere, msgs.ClangFailed(bc))
        error Failed.Reported
    }
    return $bc ".ll"
}

# B11d, -quick: each module's IR (its code - the places a Locations unit holds are data) and the runtime's compiled
# again as its object was, side by side, to assembly or (ir) optimized IR in dir, each with its remarks
fn (c mut Config&) listQuick(prog Program&, dir String&, ir Bool, out mut Listed&, d mut diag.Diagnostics&) ? Failed {
    texts Vec<String&>
    for u in prog.Units {
        if u.Holds != UnitKind.Locations { texts.Push(u.Ir) }
    }
    if prog.Runtime != "" { texts.Push(prog.Runtime) }
    if prog.Dyncall != "" { texts.Push(prog.Dyncall) }
    if c.Clang == "" { error Failed.Unbuilt }
    cmds Vec<Array<String&>&>
    sizes Vec<I64>
    for i, text in texts {
        input := $dir "/u" $i ".in.ll"
        try os.WriteFile(input, text) catch os.Error {
            fileFatal(input, msgs.CannotOpen(), d)
            error Failed.Reported
        }
        part := $dir "/u" $i $(".ll" if ir else ".s")
        args mut Vec<String&>& = Vec<String&>()
        args.Push($c.Clang)
        for f in c.CompileFlags(text) { args.Push($f) }
        args.Push("-S")
        if ir { args.Push("-emit-llvm") }
        for a in String&["-o", part, input, $"-foptimization-record-file=" $dir "/u" $i ".yaml"] { args.Push($a) }
        cmds.Push(args.ToArray())
        sizes.Push(text.Len())
        out.Parts.Push(part)
        out.Remarks.Push($dir "/u" $i ".yaml")
    }
    status, said := RunAll(cmds.ToArray(), c.width(), sizes.ToArray())
    c.Compiled += cmds.Len()
    for i in range status.Len() {
        if status[i] == 0 { continue }
        sayErr(said[i])
        d.Fatal(diag.Where.Nowhere, msgs.ClangFailed($dir "/u" $i ".in.ll"))
        error Failed.Reported
    }
    for i in range texts.Len() { try os.Remove($dir "/u" $i ".in.ll") catch os.Error { } }
}
